Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files and appends .[fileslocker@pm.me] extension
Drops ransom notes containing encrypted decryption keys
Changes desktop wallpaper to Christmas themed background
Opens a Pastebin URL with a message and master RSA decryption key
Impacted Systems: Files encrypted by FilesLocker Ransomware versions 1 and 2
Indicators of Compromise: Pastebin URL containing master RSA decryption key and message in Chinese
